pieces.Text: A demilich is immune to any spell or spell-like ability that allows spell resistance. In addition, certain spells function differently against the creature, as noted below. . A dispel evil spell deals 2d6 points of damage, with no saving throw. . Holy smite affects a demilich normally. . A power word kill spoken by an ethereal caster deals 50 points of damage to the demilich if it fails a Fortitude save (with a DC determined as though the spell allowed a saving throw). . A shatter spell deals 1d6 points of damage per two caster levels (maximum 10d6), with no saving throw.
